sanskrit: agna ā yāhi vītaye gṛṇāno havyadātaye . ni hotā satsi barhiṣi tvamagne yajñānāṃ hotā viśveṣāṃ hitaḥ .
english: O Agni, come hither for our enjoyment, praised as you are, for the giving of oblations. Sit down, O priest, upon the sacred grass; you, O Agni, are the invoking priest of all sacrifices, placed here for the good.

sanskrit: devebhirmānuṣe jane
english: Among human beings, through the gods.

sanskrit: agniṃ dūtaṃ vṛṇīmahe hotāraṃ viśvavedasam . asya yajñasya sukratum
english: We choose Agni as our messenger, as the invoking priest who knows all, the wise performer of this sacrifice.

sanskrit: agnirvṛtrāṇi jaṅghanaddraviṇasyurvipanyayā . samiddhaḥ śukra āhutaḥ
english: Agni, bright and kindled, fed with offerings, strikes down all obstructions, longing for riches, with his wondrous power.

sanskrit: preṣṭhaṃ vo atithiṃ stuṣe mitramiva priyam . agne rathaṃ na vedyam
english: I praise your most beloved guest, dear as a friend — O Agni, like a chariot worthy of being known.

sanskrit: tvaṃ no agne mahobhiḥ pāhi viśvasyā arāteḥ . uta dviṣo martyasya
english: O Agni, with your great powers protect us from all ill will, and also from the hatred of mortal men.

sanskrit: ehyū ṣu bravāṇi te 'gna itthetarā giraḥ . ebhirvardhāsa indubhiḥ
english: Come, O Agni, let me now speak to you; these other hymns are here for you. Wax mighty with these Soma drops.

sanskrit: ā te vatso mano yamatparamāccitsadhasthāt . agne tvāṃ kāmaye girā
english: The calf draws your mind even from the highest resting place, O Agni; I desire you with my song.

sanskrit: tvāmagne puṣkarādadhyatharvā niramanthata . mūrdhno viśvasya vāghataḥ
english: O Agni, Atharvan rubbed you forth from the lotus blossom, from the head of every worshipping priest.

sanskrit: agne vivasvadā bharāsmabhyamūtaye mahe . devo hyasi no dṛśe
english: O Agni, bring us, like Vivasvat, great aid for our protection; for you are truly a god for us to behold.

sanskrit: amairamitramardaya
english: Crush the ungenerous enemy.

sanskrit: dūtaṃ vo viśvavedasaṃ havyavāhamamartyam . yajiṣṭhamṛñjase girā
english: Him who knows all, the immortal carrier of oblations, the most excellent sacrificer — you adorn your messenger with a hymn.

sanskrit: upa tvā jāmayo giro dediśatīrhaviṣkṛtaḥ . vāyoranīke asthiran
english: The related hymns, pointing toward you, prepared with oblations, have taken their stand in the presence of Vāyu.

sanskrit: upa tvāgne divedive doṣāvastardhiyā vayam . namo bharanta emasi
english: O Agni, day by day, at dawn and dusk, we come to you with our thoughts, bringing homage.

sanskrit: jarābodha tadviviḍḍhi viśeviśe yajñiyāya . stomaṃ rudrāya dṛśīkam
english: O Ancient Awakener, distinguish this — for every clan, for the one worthy of worship — the hymn of praise, visible to Rudra.

sanskrit: prati tyaṃ cārumadhvaraṃ gopīthāya pra hūyase . marudbhiragna ā gahi
english: You are invoked for the protection of that beautiful, faultless sacrifice. Come, O Agni, with the Maruts.

sanskrit: aśvaṃ na tvā vāravantaṃ vandadhyā agniṃ namobhiḥ . samrājantamadhvarāṇām
english: We would honor you, O Agni, with obeisances, like a horse with a mane — you who reign over all sacrifices.

sanskrit: aurvabhṛguvacchucimapnavānavadā huve . agniṃ samudravāsasam
english: Like Aurva and Bhṛgu, I call upon the bright one, like Apnavāna — Agni, clothed in the ocean.

sanskrit: agnimindhāno manasā dhiyaṃ saceta martyaḥ . agnimindhe vivasvabhiḥ
english: The mortal who kindles Agni with his mind and thought accompanies the divine. I kindle Agni with the rays of the sun.

sanskrit: āditpratnasya retaso jyotiḥ paśyanti vāsaram . paro yadidhyate divi
english: Then men behold the light, born of the ancient seed, as the day dawns — when it blazes far away in the sky.

sanskrit: acchā naptre sahasvate
english: Toward the mighty grandson.

sanskrit: agnistigmena śociṣā yaṃsadviśvaṃ nyā3triṇam . agnirno vaṃsate rayim
english: May Agni with his sharp flame extend all-pervading, consuming every devourer. May Agni win riches for us.

sanskrit: agne mṛḍa mahāṃ asyaya ā devayuṃ janam . iyetha barhirāsadam
english: O Agni, be gracious; you are great — come to the god-loving people. You have approached to take your seat on the sacred grass.

sanskrit: agne rakṣā ṇo aṃhasaḥ prati sma deva rīṣataḥ . tapiṣṭhairajaro daha
english: O Agni, O god, guard us from sin, ward off those who would harm us. With your fiercest flames, burn them, O ageless one.

sanskrit: agne yuṅkṣvā hi ye tavāśvāso deva sādhavaḥ . araṃ vahantyāśavaḥ
english: O Agni, O god, yoke your swift steeds, those that are good and noble. The swift ones carry well.

sanskrit: ni tvā nakṣya viśpate dyumantaṃ dhīmahe vayam . suvīramagna āhuta
english: We place you, O lord of the tribe, the brilliant one, O Agni fed with oblations, to grant us brave heroes.

sanskrit: agnirmūrdhā divaḥ kakutpatiḥ pṛthivyā ayam . apāṃ retāṃsi jinvati
english: Agni is the head of heaven, the summit, the lord of the earth. He quickens the seeds of the waters.

sanskrit: imamū ṣu tvamasmākaṃ saniṃ gāyatraṃ navyāṃsam . agne deveṣu pra vocaḥ
english: Do proclaim, O Agni, this our fresh Gāyatra gain, newly composed, among the gods.

sanskrit: taṃ tvā gopavano girā janiṣṭhadagne aṅgaraḥ . sa pāvaka śrudhī havam
english: Gopavana gave you birth with his song, O Agni, O Aṅgiras. You, the purifier — hear our invocation.

sanskrit: pari vājapatiḥ kaviragnirhavyānyakramīt . dadhadratnāni dāśuṣe
english: Agni, the lord of nourishment, the wise one, has stridden around the oblations, bestowing gems upon the worshipper.

sanskrit: udu tyaṃ jātavedasaṃ devaṃ vahanti ketavaḥ . dṛśe viśvāya sūryam
english: The rays carry aloft that divine Jātavedas — the sun — to be seen by all the world.

sanskrit: kavimagnimupa stuhi satyadharmāṇamadhvare . devamamīvacātanam
english: Praise the wise Agni, the upholder of truth in the sacrifice, the god who drives away disease.

sanskrit: śaṃ no devīrabhiṣṭaye śaṃ no bhavantu pītaye . śaṃ yorabhi sravantu naḥ
english: May the divine waters be auspicious for our protection, auspicious for our drinking. May they flow toward us bringing welfare and healing.

sanskrit: kasya nūnaṃ parīṇasi dhiyo jinvasi satpate . joṣātā yasya te giraḥ
english: Whose thoughts do you now encompass and quicken, O lord of the good? Whose hymns do you delight in?

sanskrit: prapra vayamamṛtaṃ jātavedasaṃ priyaṃ mitraṃ na śaṃsiṣam
english: Let us sing forth the immortal Jātavedas, the beloved, as one praises a dear friend.

sanskrit: pāhi no agna ekayā pāhyū3ta dvitīyayā . pāhi gīrbhistisṛbhirūrjāṃ pate pāhi catasṛbhirvaso
english: Protect us, O Agni, with one hymn; protect us also with a second. Protect us, O lord of strength, with three hymns; protect us, O generous one, with four.

sanskrit: bṛhadbhiragne arcibhiḥ śukreṇa deva śociṣā . bharadvāje samidhāno yaviṣṭhya revatpāvaka dīdihi
english: O Agni, O god, with your great flames and brilliant radiance, kindled for Bharadvāja, O youngest one, O purifier rich in gifts — shine forth.

sanskrit: tve agne svāhuta priyāsaḥ santu sūrayaḥ . yantāro ye maghavāno janānāmūrvaṃ dayanta gonām
english: In you, O Agni, well-fed with oblations, may the worshippers be beloved — those lords of bounty who govern the people and share out the pen of cattle.

sanskrit: agne jaritarviśpatistapāno deva rakṣasaḥ . aproṣivāngṛhapate mahāṃ asi divaspāyurduroṇayuḥ
english: O Agni, praised singer, lord of the tribe, scorching the demons, O god — you, the tireless lord of the house, are great, the guardian of heaven, dwelling in the hall.

sanskrit: agne vivasvaduṣasaścitraṃ rādho amartya . ā dāśuṣe jātavedo vahā tvamadyā devāṃ uṣarbudhaḥ
english: O Agni, like Vivasvat, the bright reward of the dawns, O immortal, O Jātavedas — bring today the gods to the worshipper, you who rise with the dawn.

sanskrit: tvaṃ naścitra ūtyā vaso rādhāṃsi codaya . asya rāyastvamagne rathīrasi vidā gādhaṃ tuce tu naḥ
english: O bright one, O generous one, with your wonderful aid urge on the gifts. O Agni, you are the charioteer of these riches; find us a firm footing and a safe path for us.

sanskrit: tvamitsaprathā asyagne trātarṛtaḥ kaviḥ . tvāṃ viprāsaḥ samidhāna dīdiva ā vivāsanti vedhasaḥ
english: You alone, O Agni, have this fame — guardian of the cosmic order, wise one. The inspired sages, the creators of wisdom, kindle you bright and seek your favor.

sanskrit: ā no agne vayovṛdhaṃ rayiṃ pāvaka śaṃsyam . rāsvā ca na upamāte puruspṛhaṃ sunītī suyaśastaram
english: O Agni, O purifier, bring us riches that augment our strength, worthy of praise. And grant us, O matchless one, wealth longed for by many, with good guidance, bringing greater glory.

sanskrit: yo viśvā dayate vasu hotā mandro janānām . madhorna pātrā prathamānyasmai pra stomā yantvagnaye
english: He who distributes all goods, the cheerful invoking priest of the people — as honey fills the first cups, let praises flow to Agni.

sanskrit: priyaṃ cetiṣṭhamaratiṃ svādhvaraṃ viśvasya dūtamamṛtam
english: The most beloved, the most perceptive one, the minister of the perfect sacrifice, the immortal messenger of all.

sanskrit: śeṣe vaneṣu mātṛṣu saṃ tvā martāsa indhate . atandro havyaṃ vahasi haviṣkṛta ādiddeveṣu rājasi
english: You rest in the forests, among the mothers; the mortals kindle you together. Untiring, you carry the oblation, O receiver of offerings, and then you reign among the gods.

sanskrit: adarśi gātuvittamo yasminvratāya ādadhuḥ . upo ṣu jātamāryasya vardhanamagniṃ nakṣantu no giraḥ
english: He has been seen, the best knower of the way, in whom they have placed their vows. May our hymns go forth to Agni, born and nourished, the increaser of the noble.

sanskrit: agnirukthe purohito grāvāṇo barhiradhvare . ṛcā yāmi maruto brahmaṇaspate devā avo vareṇyam
english: Agni is the household priest established in the hymn; the pressing stones and sacred grass are in the sacrifice. With a verse I invoke the Maruts, Brahmaṇaspati, and the gods — the most excellent protection.
